goal: Scala review: implicit scope, blocking in futures, pattern match gaps and serialisation.
use: Scala review: implicit scope, blocking in futures, pattern match gaps and serialisation. Use when asked to review a Scala project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. The build tool, Scala version and compiler flags.
Check implicits. Flag implicits that change behaviour silently.
Check futures. Flag blocking calls inside futures.
Check matches. Flag non-exhaustive pattern matches on sealed types.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
